glosses: weave, texture (a type or way of weaving)
tissue (a group of cells similar in origin that function together to do a specific job)

examples.text: Este cesto fue tejido con ramas de sauce.
examples.en: This basket was woven from willow.

examples.text: Escocia es famosa por sus tejidos de lana.
examples.en: Scotland is famous for its woollen textiles.

examples.text: Secar este tejido a alta temperatura podría causar encogimiento.
examples.en: Drying this fabric at a high temperature may cause shrinkage.
